subject: Sequenced acceptance plan + invoice tranche proposal for LedgerTech renewal
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@ledgertech.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: LedgerTech Procurement <procurement@ledgertech.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: LedgerTech renewal — sequencing and billing preference

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. LedgerTech is ready to move forward on a 24-month commitment, but procurement has two asks before we issue a PO:

1) We need to split the initial year invoice into two tranches due to budget phasing across Q3/Q4.
2) We prefer an accelerated acceptance schedule so we can enable production earlier (goal: pilot traffic in 6 weeks).

Can Redwood accommodate:
- An invoice split 60/40 (first tranche due on signature, second tranche 90 days later) and
- A staged acceptance: sandbox -> canary (2 weeks) -> prod-enable (weeks 5-6) with documented signoff at each stage.

If that works, procurement would draft the PO and include a reference to Redwood's private-offer export on AWS. We will also need an updated private-offer export zip and a draft PO to attach to our internal approval flow.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement, LedgerTech
Elena.Ruiz@ledgertech.com

Attachments: none

Subject: Re: LedgerTech renewal — sequencing and billing preference

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear asks. We can support both items but will need to coordinate across Marketplace billing and our Private deployment team to generate the export and staging plan.

Proposed next steps (short):
- I will pull the AWS private-offer export and share with you (Marissa will confirm marketplace-specific fields).
- Ben (cc'd) will draft an acceptance sequencing doc that maps milestones to success criteria and signoff owners.
- If procurement can draft the PO with a 60/40 split and target signature date, we will prepare the DocuSign bundle.

Can you confirm the exact invoice due dates your finance team prefers for the second tranche (e.g., 90 days after signature vs a fixed calendar date)? Also confirm whether LedgerTech needs VAT-inclusive invoices (I believe so given EU operations).

I'll loop in Soojin from Marketplace ops in my internal note so we get the private-offer export with the correct billing fields. If everyone agrees, we can put a short 30-minute call on calendar next week to finalize dates.

Thanks,
Ava Chen

ava.chen@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: LedgerTech renewal — sequencing and billing preference

Ava / Marissa — quick internal note to formalize the staging plan and billing handoff so our Ops/legal folks have something to validate before Elena's PO lands.

Summary (draft):
- Acceptance milestones:
  * Sandbox provisioned (Day 0) — LedgerTech confirms connectivity and baseline tests.
  * Canary (Day 14) — run limited production traffic (<= 10% of target QPS). Success criteria: latency < 200ms p50, no errors > 0.5%. Signoff: LedgerTech SRE + Redwood CS.
  * Prod enable (Day 35–42) — full routing. Success criteria: meet throughput and SLOs documented in the rollout playbook.

- Billing / invoice tranche proposal:
  * Tranche 1: 60% on signature (invoice due net 30 by default; LedgerTech requested 60/40 w/ second tranche 90 days later — need exact date).
  * Tranche 2: 40% invoiced 90 days after signature (or fixed date if they prefer).
  * Marketplace note: AWS private-offer export must include VAT flag and customer billing contact. Marissa, can you confirm if the export can include an explicit invoice-tranche reference field?

Operational asks:
- Soojin: please generate a private-offer export with the following fields: customer legal name, billing contact, VAT-inclusive price per unit, and a tags field that we can reference (e.g., "tranche:60-40"). Also include a brief readme (1–2 lines) for procurement on how to reference the private-offer ID in the PO.
- Marissa: confirm whether Redwood can do a DocuSign bundle that includes both PO and acceptance checklist so procurement can sign both documents in one flow.

I will assemble a short PDF (acceptance matrix + signoff owners) and drop it in the HubSpot deal record (linked). Once Soojin shares the export, I'll attach it to the PO template and send to Elena.

Ben
Senior Renewal Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: Acceptance_Matrix_Draft.pdf (will attach once approved)

- Acceptance dates: sandbox provision by 2027-06-14; canary window 2027-06-28 to 2027-07-12; prod enable target 2027-07-20 (final signoff by LedgerTech SRE).
